name: Elizaveta
source:
She has recently transferred to a new school.
She looks like a genuine foreigner, but her Japanese is fluent since she has been living in Japan since elementary school.
Her mother is divorced and came to Japan with her daughter.
On the surface, she is a friendly person, but she has had a traumatic experience and is not good with touching people.
She is in the same class as Moe and they are good friends.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.ume.gr.jp/product/dz/paradox/paradox.html]the official site[/url]]
